remarks: Welcome to 70 Strawberry Hill Avenue! This spacious, updated studio features classic charm with modern touches, including gleaming hardwood floors and 9-foot ceilings throughout. The kitchen has been updated, and the large open living area includes a dedicated dining space-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The well-maintained grounds feature a peaceful center courtyard with a park-like setting. Monthly common charges cover heat and hot water, and the complex offers ample rear parking along with on-site laundry. Ideally located just steps from downtown Stamford, restaurants, Metro-North, and local parks.
